next_work: Give IF and IH the same capital line the hedged arms have (per-lot vol at the 8% target): only then can the four-arm opening cost be stated instead of floored.
sentence: The four-arm book is priced at 7.938%/yr, Sharpe 3.412 on 2.246% vol, and it cannot be opened on the 1,000,000 CNY book: IC is 124,479 CNY short of its first lot (target 8.0%); IM is 152,596 CNY short of its first lot (target 8.0%). Holding one lot of every measured arm needs at least 2,277,075 CNY, so this book is a number about a larger account until the capital arrives. That floor covers only the arms with a capital line (IC, IM); IF, IH have none, so the true opening cost is higher and this face will not guess it.
